authentication.rate_limit_scope: global per API key across subscriber endpoints

authorization.enforcement: role permission intersected with API-key scopes
authorization.mutation_consistency: Principal-authorized API-key, member, governance, policy-pack, project, worker, run-reservation creation, and subscription-cancellation mutations repeat live authorization inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as the write

quota_meters: certification runs per authoritative subscription current_period_start/current_period_end

lifecycle.billing_events: provider timestamp plus monotonic sequence; stale events are persisted as rejected and cannot mutate lifecycle state
lifecycle.billing_periods: activation, reactivation, renewal, and plan-change events require valid current_period_start/current_period_end and replace both boundaries atomically
lifecycle.plan_changes: plan changes atomically cap retention and disable governance controls that the destination plan does not entitle without changing PAST_DUE, SUSPENDED, or CANCELLED lifecycle state
lifecycle.nonstarted_revocation: past-due, suspension, and cancellation atomically release unstarted reservations, cancel queued runs, and cancel pending or claimed dispatches
lifecycle.reactivation: only an ordered subscription.activated or subscription.reactivated event may leave PAST_DUE or SUSPENDED

audit.final_request_outcomes: every request with a valid bearer credential records final path, status, tenant-match, reason, and allowed/denied/error outcome, including validation failures and unhandled exceptions

worker_execution.claim_precondition: subscriber execution requires an existing QUEUED run and matching BOUND subscriber_run_reservation
worker_execution.claim_binding: tenant, project, policy, target type, target reference, and target identity digest must match persisted run and reservation state
worker_execution.dispatch: API intake atomically materializes the deterministic run, BOUND metered reservation, idempotency record, and exact transactional outbox in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; legacy partial intake is restart-safe and can only complete the same run_id or terminalize cleanly
worker_execution.claim_transition: BOUND to EXECUTING is atomic and leased before target acquisition; duplicate/direct claims fail closed
worker_execution.identity_reconciliation: after acquisition and before customer execution, canonical acquired target and worker environment identities must exactly match their declared digests and persisted reservation binding, then replace declaration placeholders atomically
worker_execution.execution_boundary: immediately before customer execution, canonical identities, subscription, and governance are revalidated in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that moves QUEUED to ACQUIRING_TARGET and EXECUTING to STARTED with both versions
worker_execution.leases: dispatcher and worker claims have expirations; active worker claims heartbeat before expiry, heartbeat loss terminates active customer execution, and signing plus completion require the same active unexpired lease
worker_execution.crash_recovery: expired pre-start claims requeue without compensation until the bounded retry limit; exhaustion or an expired STARTED claim terminalizes as infrastructure failure, releases concurrency, fails dispatch, and receives one idempotent meter compensation
worker_execution.entitlement_source: SubscriberGovernance is resolved at claim and revalidated immediately before RunExecutor execution
worker_execution.retention_source: active subscriber plan/governance retention is revalidated immediately before RunExecutor execution and capped at the current plan maximum
worker_execution.private_worker_only: requires a matching ACTIVE tenant worker identity and attestation digest
worker_execution.local_only_execution: requires a local target and local execution location
worker_execution.customer_managed_signing: requires customer signing authority and the configured customer_signing_key_id
worker_execution.lookup_failure_mode: fail closed without executing or continuing the target
worker_execution.deploy_smoke: staging and production smoke provision isolated organizations, projects, and API keys, authenticate every governed request with project_id, and exercise cross-tenant isolation with a second authenticated tenant
